_meta: Edit-decision list for build.py (v4, 2026-10-22, after the review: 75–90 s, a cut every 2–4 s, no static card over 3 s, hook paid off by 0:20, founder in the first 30 s, ends on living eyes, no CE card). Times in seconds. kind: clip | film (full '[PROTOTYPE SHOT — to film]' card: F01, F09) | image | soulos | chatbox | odds | privacy | honesty | end. standin = the real shot that replaces this picture (a '[PROTOTYPE SHOT — to film]' banner over the stand-in). label keys map to facts.json labels in build.py. {{path}} pulls a value from facts.json; {{colours_n_word}}, {{delivery_eu}}, {{ce_vo}} are derived. Scale shots only from renders/v10 (S) or the true-scale graphic; never v9 hand/desk/typing, never the trailer 19.2-22.2 s hand. One eye style only (the flat SoulOS eyes): no soul_eye_v1, no v9 launch film, no trailer peach-gradient scenes. no_tts = no guide voice (the founder speaks). music = the licensed track (Mixkit 464, trailer/MUSIC-LICENSE.md) starts here; music_ss = where in the track.

film_shots.title: The wake, in one take
film_shots.action: SOUL S asleep on the desk (standby: only the eyes). One finger taps the glass: the eyes open, look around, look into the lens. The finger slides left and right, the eyes follow. The hand leaves; after a few seconds the eyes get sleepy and doze.
film_shots.framing: 3/4 front, lens at glass height, phone 2x lens, locked on a tripod. 25 s continuous take; we use 8 s of it, the full take goes on the page as proof.
film_shots.proof: A phone lock screen showing the date and time, readable, in the background left for the whole take.

film_shots.title: Birth at first power-on
film_shots.action: A brand-new SOUL S is switched on for the first time. The chip ID appears, then the eyes it is born with. Then My SOUL shows the name, rarity and chip ID.
film_shots.framing: Top-down, phone parallel to the glass, 1x lens at 25-30 cm, exposure locked 0.7 stop under so the AMOLED stays true black.
film_shots.proof: Dated clock beside the unit. Film three units in a row, uncut, so viewers see different eyes come out.

film_shots.title: Hold the glass, ask your own AI
film_shots.action: The founder rests a finger on the glass: listening ring. He asks a real question (e.g. 'Remind me to call Mum at six'). He lifts the finger; Claude's reply appears and is spoken; the reminder is created.
film_shots.framing: Medium close-up, 3/4, founder's hand and SOUL in frame, his face out of focus. Lavalier mic on the founder; SOUL's own speaker recorded clean.
film_shots.proof: Dated clock in frame. Settings > Your AI shows the keys with the keys hidden; never show an API key. Film only what works on the S board at G1: if voice for Claude-only owners isn't ready, the speech-to-text key (your own OpenAI key) is shown in Settings and the on-screen note stays.

film_shots.title: Claude app puts a plan on SOUL
film_shots.action: On the laptop, in the Claude app (founder's own account), he types: 'Put tomorrow's plan on my SOUL.' SOUL, next to the laptop, reacts and the plan appears on the glass.
film_shots.framing: One wide take showing laptop and SOUL together, then a close-up of the glass. Blur any personal data on the laptop. No Anthropic logo close-ups.
film_shots.proof: Dated clock (the laptop's own clock is fine if readable).

film_shots.title: Offline: still alive
film_shots.action: The router is switched off (its lights go out) or Wi-Fi is turned off on SOUL. SOUL keeps blinking; the founder sets an alarm and writes a note. Settings shows 'no AI'.
film_shots.framing: Wide shot with the router in frame, then a close-up of the glass.
film_shots.proof: Dated clock in frame, router lights visible.

film_shots.title: SoulOS on the real S glass
film_shots.action: Thumb turns the dial of pebbles, opens Notes, scrolls a wheel list, closes it; the lids open and close; the eyes come back.
film_shots.framing: Macro straight-on, phone on an overhead arm parallel to the glass, focus locked, exposure -0.7, shutter 1/50 (25 fps) to avoid AMOLED flicker.
film_shots.proof: One continuous take; dated clock at the frame edge.

film_shots.title: In the hand: the real size
film_shots.action: Open palm, SOUL S resting in it, slow turn to show the {{size_S.display_dims}} body. Second take: on the table next to a bank card and a 2-euro coin.
film_shots.framing: Eye level, 1x lens, neutral background, soft side light so the bead-blasted aluminium reads. ONLY the S unit here: never the M prototype.
film_shots.proof: Ruler or calipers in the second take reading {{size_S.width_mm}} mm.

film_shots.title: Privacy, in one gesture
film_shots.action: Finger rests on the glass: the listening ring appears. Finger lifts: the ring disappears at once, the eyes relax. Then turn SOUL around: no camera anywhere.
film_shots.framing: Macro 3/4, focus on the glass edge, dark background.
film_shots.proof: One take, dated clock in frame.

film_shots.title: The founder, to camera
film_shots.action: The founder at the bench in Bucharest, to camera, 10–15 s, in his own words: who he is and why he built SOUL. It sits at 0:15–0:26 of the film (review: the founder in the first 30 s). On the bench: the M prototype and SOUL S side by side, each with a small card 'M prototype' / 'S'. While M is in frame, the M label stays on screen.
film_shots.framing: Eye level, 1x lens, soft key light 45 degrees, lavalier mic, 10–15 s.
film_shots.proof: Real person, real place. No actors, no stock footage.

film_shots.title: Vertical: SOUL wakes in the hand
film_shots.action: SOUL S in the palm, a thumb touches the glass, the eyes open and look at the lens.
film_shots.proof: Dated clock in a longer take kept as proof. Only the S unit.

film_shots.title: The finish, in macro
film_shots.action: Slow macro slide across the bead-blasted, anodised aluminium of SOUL S (each launch colour), ending on the edge of the black glass while the eyes open.
film_shots.framing: Macro lens or phone macro mode, raking side light so the bead-blast grain reads, 3 × 4 s.
film_shots.proof: Only the real S shells; no render.
